_purpose: Pair-to-strategy registry for the PAPER executors. Maps every monitored pair to its assigned strategy, executor, timeframe, version, tradeable state, and bounded risk profile. Consumed by app/user_data/strategies/PaperAutonomous.py (daily), app/user_data/strategies/MomentumAlt.py (fast), app/scripts/preflight.py, and app/scripts/crypto_status_monitor.py. BTC's baseline math is NOT defined here — it lives in BtcZScore and is preserved by subclassing.
